EPUB components

assets/readium/readium-css/fonts/LICENSE-AccessibleDfa and LICENSE-IaWriterDuospace.md.

Kotlin Koi core 0.5.5 (Readium streamer dependency)

Apache-2.0; see koi-APACHE-2.0.txt.

kotlinx.serialization, kotlinx.datetime, Timber and desugar_jdk_libs are
distributed under Apache-2.0. License text: PhotoView-APACHE-2.0.txt.
